q2_need_solana_wallet.reason: V8 is read-only analysis only; no transaction construction; per spec '不得选择 probe/live/canary/wallet/keypair'

q3_need_extra_tokens.reason: V8 is theoretical EV only; no token acquisition; 'notional' column is theoretical (10U USDC input -> X output)

q6_just_exploratory_connector_probe.answer: V8 is preflight design only, NOT probe. If next stage is 10_20U_PROBE_PREFLIGHT_DESIGN_V1, that would design (no execute). If EV positive, separate stage executes probe (with operator keypair).

q7_expand_known_pool_feed_instead_of_pro.reason: 10-20U X/USDC EV is all negative; expanding pool feed to find higher-fee Meteora DLMM pools or other AMM protocols (Raydium, Orca) has better ROI; paid RPC for SOL/USDC deferrable

key_finding: 10/20U X/USDC probe is NOT worth it under V8 EV model (heuristic-based; missing actual volume/IL). Net EV is structurally negative at retail notionals for X/USDC given (a) low base fee (1.5%), (b) low assumed volume, (c) fixed cost (~$0.16 round-trip + setup). Real EV could be different if (a) actual volume is 10x+ higher, (b) max_fee (10%) kicks in, (c) zero_il_lvr is realistic for tight notional windows.

summary_decision.10_20U_preflight_design_worth: false (no point if no probe coming)
summary_decision.survival_ev_honest_report: NEGATIVE for X/USDC at 10-2000 USD notionals (best case -$0.156; worst ~-$0.36; 84/168 near break-even but all negative)
